rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides comprehensive EMC/RF regulatory compliance data for engineers working on electronic device certification. The server includes emission limits from FCC Part 15 (unintentional and intentional radiators), Part 18 (ISM equipment), CISPR standards (11, 22, 32, 14-1), and automotive-specific standards like CISPR 25 component limits and CISPR 12 vehicle-level limits. It also covers immunity testing standards (ISO 11452-2, ISO 7637-2), restricted frequency bands, ISM bands, and cellular band plans for LTE and 5G NR. The implementation enables engineers to quickly look up applicable limits for specific frequencies, compare standards between regions, identify restricted bands, and understand automotive EMC class requirements, making it valuable for product development, pre-compliance testing, and certification planning.
